title: Velocita — Live account & execution
description: Supervised live swap. Read-only service status, reviewed account snapshots, durable order progress and cost boundaries.

panels.title: Live operation — service readiness is not trading authorization

targets.expr: clamp_min(velocita_live_review_expires_seconds{run="$live_run"} - time(), 0) and on() (time() - velocita_live_observer_observed_seconds < 45) and on() (velocita_live_observer_up == 1)

panels.title: Account snapshot — last verified venue balances, not a live wallet poll
Account evidence age
panels.description: Age of the account snapshot this run was approved against. It is fixed for the run; the review lasts 24 hours from it. Live balances are re-read before every trade.

targets.expr: time() - velocita_live_account_observed_seconds{run="$live_run"} and on() (time() - velocita_live_observer_observed_seconds < 45) and on() (velocita_live_observer_up == 1)

panels.title: Reviewed USDC snapshots
panels.description: Only changes when reviewed account history is replaced. Sampling this observer does not refresh the wallet evidence.

panels.title: Reviewed SOL snapshots

panels.title: Live SOL price and signal — strategy driver
Live SOL price with confirmed entries / exits
panels.description: Binance SOLUSDT proxy close and EMAs. Each green/red point is one confirmed effect at its effective price and persisted first-confirmed observation time, not chain execution time. Repeated scrapes do not create additional entries or exits.

max by (effect, side, first_observed_ms) (velocita_live_fill_effective_price_usdc_per_sol{run="$live_run",side="sell"} and on() (time() - velocita_live_observer_observed_seconds < 45) and on() (velocita_live_observer_up == 1))

panels.title: Live stochastic K and D
panels.description: Entry: K crosses above D with K at 60 or more while EMA 300 s is above EMA 1200 s, held 3 seconds. Exit: K below D with K at 40 or less, held 3 seconds.

targets.legendFormat: 60: entry needs K at or above
40: exit needs K at or below

panels.title: Live entries / exits — authenticated Raft settlement records
Confirmed-fill telemetry
panels.description: Optional authenticated settlement snapshot. Missing or invalid data never means zero trades or zero balances.

targets.expr: time() - velocita_live_settlement_observed_seconds{run="$live_run"} and on() (time() - velocita_live_observer_observed_seconds < 45) and on() (velocita_live_observer_up == 1)

panels.title: Live SOL entries / exits — effective settled price
panels.description: Bounded run history: at most 16 finalized successful effects; the kernel stops at capacity. Green buy / red sell; a sell may only reduce a position. X-axis is FIRST CONFIRMED OBSERVATION by this collector, persisted across restarts, not chain execution time. One instant-table row per effect prevents repeated scrape markers. Buy = total USDC debit / net SOL credit; sell = net USDC credit / SOL debit. No quote, pending order or deposit is a fill. Source age is shown above; these are ledger balances, not continuous wallet polls.

targets.expr: max by (effect, side, first_observed_ms, quantity_sol, quote_usdc, fee_usdc) (velocita_live_fill_effective_price_usdc_per_sol{run="$live_run",side="buy"} and on() (time() - velocita_live_observer_observed_seconds < 45) and on() (velocita_live_observer_up == 1))

max by (effect, side, first_observed_ms, quantity_sol, quote_usdc, fee_usdc) (velocita_live_fill_effective_price_usdc_per_sol{run="$live_run",side="sell"} and on() (time() - velocita_live_observer_observed_seconds < 45) and on() (velocita_live_observer_up == 1))

panels.title: Retained confirmed fills — first-observed time, quantities and explicit fees
panels.description: All successful effects retained for this bounded run, at most 16; no eviction. Effective price already incorporates actual net debit/credit; explicit USDC fee is informational and must not be added twice. Initial and externally deposited holdings are not trade entries.

targets.expr: max by (effect, side, first_observed_ms, quantity_sol, quote_usdc, fee_usdc) (velocita_live_fill_effective_price_usdc_per_sol{run="$live_run"} and on() (time() - velocita_live_observer_observed_seconds < 45) and on() (velocita_live_observer_up == 1))

panels.title: Ledger realized P&L
panels.description: Realized only, from the authenticated ledger and its reviewed opening cost basis. Not marked-to-market equity; does not value open SOL.

panels.title: SOL position — authenticated ledger snapshots
panels.description: Last observed authenticated Raft balance. Snapshot age above distinguishes held stale state from fresh accounting. External deposits require reconciliation; collector does not poll TM.

panels.title: USDC balance — authenticated ledger snapshots
panels.description: Last observed ledger quote balance, not a continuously polled venue wallet.

panels.title: Quote preparation
panels.description: 1 idle; 2 started; 3 recorded result. A prepared quote, signature or submission result is not proof of a settled fill.

panels.title: Protected signing
panels.description: TRADE SETTLED requires fresh successful settlement evidence for the same run and effect as the retained signing record. Otherwise this shows the raw journal phase; a retained record alone does not prove signing succeeded or the trade failed. The signer resolves its predecessor when authorizing a subsequent effect. Raw phases remain below for recovery diagnostics.

targets.expr: ((4 * max by (run) (count_values by (run) ("effect", velocita_live_protected_signing_effect{run="$live_run"}) and on (run, effect) (velocita_live_fill_effective_price_usdc_per_sol{run="$live_run"} and on (run) (velocita_live_settlement_feed_status{run="$live_run"} == 1)))) or on (run) velocita_live_protected_signing_phase{run="$live_run"}) and on() (time() - velocita_live_observer_observed_seconds < 45) and on() (velocita_live_observer_up == 1)

panels.title: Venue submission
panels.description: 1 idle; 2 started; 3 recorded result. A prepared quote, signature or submission result is not proof of a settled fill.

panels.title: Automatic service restarts
panels.description: Services currently use Restart=no. A stopped service does not imply a failed trade.

panels.title: Configured maximum buy output deduction
panels.description: Conservative signer allowance. It is not an observed fee or expected cost.

panels.title: How to read this supervised MVP

options.content:
**Scope:** one separately authorized $1 total-debit SOL buy; $0.002 explicit fee cap; $0.50 realized-loss limit. No automatic strategy, retries, second trade or sell. The loss limit is not a guaranteed market stop-loss.

**Cost evidence:** 20 bp explicit fee plus an observed 0.000550840 SOL buy-output deduction on the prior owner trade. The configured 0.002039280 SOL maximum is a conservative allowance with zero assumed sponsor credit. These are different quantities; neither establishes future route costs.

**Balances:** last reviewed TM/on-chain account snapshot. The age above advances even while the observer is healthy. Deposits or trades after that timestamp are not reflected until reconciliation refreshes the evidence.

**Settlement:** finalized successful authenticated Raft records supply net quantities, effective prices and realized ledger P&L. Markers use the collector’s first confirmed observation time, not the exact execution time, and retain all effects for this bounded run (capacity 16). Missing or stale settlement telemetry is explicit. No quote or submission creates a marker.

**Expiry:** account review expiry stops this supervised runtime. Preserve all recovery journals; never initialize again to restart. Paper metrics remain on the separate Paper trading tab.
